no-restricted-syntax.message: Avoid physical directional classes (left-*, right-*). Use logical equivalents: start-*, end-*. If intentional (eye-toggle, carousel, centering idiom), add // rtl-ok comment and use eslint-disable-next-line.
Avoid physical margin classes (ml-*, mr-*). Use logical equivalents: ms-*, me-*. If intentional, add // rtl-ok comment and use eslint-disable-next-line.
Avoid physical padding classes (pl-*, pr-*). Use logical equivalents: ps-*, pe-*. If intentional (e.g. pr-11 pl-4 password input pair), add // rtl-ok comment and use eslint-disable-next-line.
